enunciado: In {31, -4, 57, 12, 57, -9, 0} find the largest and the smallest with their positions (first occurrence), and the second largest value different from the largest.
objetivos: Keep positions as well as values
Solve variants of the maximum problem
pistas: Start by assuming element 0 is both the largest and the smallest.
Use > (not >=) to keep the first occurrence.
For the second largest ignore values equal to the largest.
